reviewFindings.issue: Unverified chat addresses could change growth records
reviewFindings.verification: Real chat start and follow-up cannot opt out a known contact, suppress email, create lifecycle events or cancel another product draft; signed email ingestion still stops sequences.

reviewFindings.issue: Deferred accounting retained a settled persisted reservation
reviewFindings.verification: Runtime tests cover successful cost retry, already-booked cost and release failure/retry without double booking.

reviewFindings.issue: Every first product event invented a trial
reviewFindings.verification: Eleven first-event cases verify actual stage/owner; observations, replies and meetings do not create onboarding work.

reviewFindings.issue: Replies inherited the previous conversation timestamp
reviewFindings.verification: Cancellation in an old thread records the new message timestamp and triggers recovery after a newer renewal.

reviewFindings.issue: Late unchanged events stranded cancelled draft generations
reviewFindings.verification: Late signup and trial events preserve the proposed onboarding message and version; a subsequent sweep adds no duplicate and the existing approval can still claim the message.

reviewFindings.issue: An existing tenant mapping could not be cleared
reviewFindings.verification: Omitted mapping stays set; explicit empty clears it; moving the tenant routes its next event to the correct organization.

reviewFindings.issue: Growth and native lifecycle emails had separate contact-gap checks
reviewFindings.verification: Growth-first, lifecycle-first and concurrent database claims admit exactly one recipient reservation; the other workflow remains blocked until the configured gap elapses. Native replay and per-day caps remain intact.

reviewFindings.issue: Growth preview could send credentialed requests
reviewFindings.verification: Preview read and mutation attempts are rejected before fetch; connected-mode UI behavior remains covered.

reviewFindings.issue: Native activity displaced usage evidence from other products
reviewFindings.verification: Mixed CareBase activity and Intel usage retain an Intel stopped-use alert; overlapping metrics use the latest valid observation.

reviewFindings.issue: Financial health bands hid adoption-evidence gaps in the report
reviewFindings.verification: A cancellation-watch account with no activity is still counted as missing fresh adoption evidence.

reviewFindings.issue: Selecting the same opportunity cleared its detail view
reviewFindings.verification: Repeated selection preserves evidence and message history, including unknown delivery details.

validation.database: isolated local Supabase PostgreSQL 15.1 with official auth and storage schema prerequisites
validation.growthIntegration: passed twice with identity, chronology, event initialization, pending drafts, tenant remapping, cross-workflow contact frequency and teardown regressions
